other_conditions: The applicant must be an Indian citizen.
The applicant must be enlisted in the Permanent Waiting List (PWL) based on SECC 2011 data.
The applicant must be from a houseless household or living in a kutcha or dilapidated house.
benefits_summary: Provides ₹130,000 financial assistance for constructing a pucca house, along with wage support and assistance for toilet construction.
